member.name: T:Tempo.Telemetry.TempoTelemetry
member.summary:
Tempo's telemetry emitter. Owns the process-wide and named , and exposes typed, bounded-cardinality recording methods for every Tempo component.
Emission rides the .NET base class library only. Nothing is exported until a host subscribes to the Tempo meter and activity source (for example with Radiant, the OpenTelemetry SDK, or dotnet-counters); unobserved instruments cost a few nanoseconds and allocate nothing.
All members are thread-safe. Every recording method is best-effort: it never throws, so instrumentation can never break the code path it observes. Identifiers and free-form text are only ever placed on spans, never on metric labels.
